CustomObject.description: Org-wide toggle for GTM_Readout__c approval routing: manager-approves (default, via the GTM_Readout_Approval ApprovalProcess) or the creating rep self-approves (via GtmReadoutController.selfApproveReadout, which is paired with a GTM_Readout_Approval_Log__c audit row). Edited from the GTM_Readout_Approval_Settings tab, not Setup.
CustomObject.label: GTM Readout Approval Settings
